meta.disclaimer: Reference ranges are versioned prototype norms from preliminary contactless cohorts. They are not FDA-cleared diagnostic thresholds and are explicitly labeled as decision-support placeholders.

no_flag.guidance: Measurements are nominal and within expected baseline variance.

watch.guidance: Observed mild variation from reference baseline. Routine periodic monitoring recommended.

review_advised.guidance: Notable deviation or behavioral pattern observed. Clinical review by a qualified physician is advised.

pattern_rules.title: Slowness with reduced movement amplitude
pattern_rules.explanation: Observed simultaneous reduction in finger-tapping cadence and peak opening amplitude compared to reference norm.

pattern_rules.title: Observed left-right movement asymmetry
pattern_rules.explanation: Bilateral comparison indicates noticeable asymmetry between right and left performance (> 20% motor difference or < 82% smile symmetry).

pattern_rules.title: Irregular motor rhythm and hesitations
pattern_rules.explanation: Inter-tap interval variance indicates cadence irregularity or intermittent movement hesitation.

pattern_rules.title: Multimodal behavioral coordination changes
pattern_rules.explanation: Evidence from both motor tapping rhythm and rapid speech articulation ('pa-ta-ka') shows concurrent coordination variability.
